description: The epic's last constitutional act. Same instrument and same prohibition as waves 1 and 2: publish is not idempotent (allocate_next_id is max+1, .harness/bin/precedent.py:683-696), conflicts is blind to perfect clones by design (:2074), and PR-032's ratio records what that combination produced - duplicates 'minted minutes apart by the same agent on the same task through retry inadvertence'. acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY the new PR-NNN.json files it mints. No existing record, no precedent.py, no PRECEDENT.md, no INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, no README, no ORCHESTRATION.md, no NLAH file, no test file, and above all NO .harness/state.json write. PUBLISH EXACTLY THE LEDGER'S WAVE-3 ROWS in ledger order using T-388's quoted commands verbatim; a row you cannot publish as quoted is a BLOCKED handoff naming the row and the refusal message.
